title: Common
description: Shared definitions. Every convention that more than one contract relies on is written here once and referenced from the other schemas.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this file (unitless integer). Bumped on any breaking change to the file's schema.

generated_at.description: Instant this file was generated, UTC ISO 8601 with Z.

utc_iso.description: Instant in UTC, ISO 8601 with a literal Z suffix, e.g. 2026-11-14T12:00:00Z. No local offsets.

source_urls.description: URLs of every upstream dataset or API this file was derived from (no units). At least one.

slug.description: Lower-case identifier used in file names (no units): letters, digits and hyphens.

lat_deg.description: Planetocentric latitude in degrees, Moon-fixed mean-Earth frame (MOON_ME), in [-90, 90]; south is negative.

lon_deg.description: East-positive longitude in degrees, Moon-fixed mean-Earth frame (MOON_ME), in [-180, 180). 180 itself is written as -180.

elev_m.description: Terrain height in metres above the 1737400 m reference sphere (negative below it).

azimuth_deg.description: Azimuth in degrees, clockwise from local north as seen from above (north 0, east 90), in [0, 360).

elevation_deg.description: Angle in degrees above the local horizontal plane (the plane perpendicular to the radial through the site), in [-90, 90]; negative is below the plane. No refraction.

crs.description: Projection name (no units). Always south polar stereographic on a sphere; parameters are in crs_params.

crs_params.description: Parameters of the south polar stereographic projection, true scale at the pole (k0 = 1). With rho = 2 * radius_m * tan(pi/4 + lat/2) (lat in radians, negative in the south): x = rho * sin(lon), y = rho * cos(lon). So +y points along longitude 0 (towards Earth) and +x along longitude 90 east.

lat_0.description: Latitude of the projection origin in degrees: the south pole.

lon_0.description: Central longitude in degrees: the meridian that maps to the +y axis.

radius_m.description: Radius of the reference sphere in metres.

x0.description: Projected x in metres of the CENTRE of cell (col 0, row 0). Raster axis convention, defined only here: col grows with +x, row grows with +y, so the centre of cell (col, row) is (x0 + col * cell_m, y0 + row * cell_m). Cells are stored row-major: index = row * nx + col. Binary values are little-endian.

y0.description: Projected y in metres of the CENTRE of cell (col 0, row 0). See x0 for the axis convention.

cell_m.description: Cell size in projected metres, the same along x and y.

nx.description: Number of columns (cells along +x); unitless count.

ny.description: Number of rows (cells along +y); unitless count.
